title: Normalized tensor comparison on finite intrinsic cochain complexes
statement: Let X be a scheme and A a finite commutative ring. For arbitrary cochain complexes P and Q of fixed-A-module sheaves on the small etale site, the termwise intrinsic comparison has a unique isomorphism from the comparison of their signed total tensor to the intrinsic signed total tensor of their comparisons. It is characterized by the following normalization: there is a natural ordinary tensor comparison, normalized on all etale pure sections through the two adjunction units, such that on every total summand p+q=k the chain map is the composite of that ordinary comparison and the intrinsic summand inclusion. Equivalently its value on every etale local total pure generator is the total pure generator of the compared sections. No boundedness, flatness or constructibility is assumed.

source.place: lemma-tensor-product-pullback (03EK), totalization in Cohomology on Sites 06YN

proof.text: Use the natural ordinary tensor isomorphism and its pure-tensor formula. The comparison is the composite of a left adjoint and the finite intrinsic realization equivalence, hence preserves the coproducts of the total complex. Curry the ordinary natural isomorphism and apply the total-bifunctor comparison; its components are isomorphisms. Additivity respects the signed total differential.
The comparison identity on each total summand, followed by naturality of the section unit and the ordinary tensor generator identity, proves the normalization for t.

For uniqueness compare degree maps by coproduct extensionality after the colimit-preserving comparison. For each summand, the module-sheafification and site comparison adjunctions reduce equality to maps from the original etale tensor sheaf. Sheaf tensor extensionality then reduces to pure sections. The two normalization equations and the given formula for t agree on all these sections.
